[[Marten Sirl]]'s '''daughter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] living in the town of [[Vexen]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kallistas]]. She received a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arm replacement thanks to [[Jondrell Inx]].
